item.title: Version 1.3.94
item.description:
- Publish now checks GitHub up front: if GitHub has newer commits than this Mac (from another computer or session) the inspection shows a blocking item in plain English, naming the folders that changed and the latest change, with a one-click "Sync now" button. Previously publishing did all its work and only failed at the final push.
- Sync is a normal merge that backs out cleanly (nothing left half-merged) if local edits are in the way, and explains what to do.
- New warning when Settings still points at a *.pages.dev address, since canonical links, the sitemap and link previews would use it instead of your real domain.
- An offline or slow network never blocks publishing: the GitHub check is skipped quietly.
